caption: The drawing depicts a metal stove with a rectangular body that tapers slightly toward the top, ending in a circular stovepipe collar. The stove is rendered in shades of brown and dark gray, suggesting a rusty or aged iron surface. It has a front-facing rectangular door secured by metal hinges and a latch, and there appears to be a smaller intake or vent below the main door. The stove sits on four curved, iron legs, which extend below an oval-shaped, slightly raised base or tray. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or scenery present. The lower left of the image contains the handwritten name "J. Glover, Westchester County," and the lower right identifies the object as a "Shaker Stove (preliminary drawing) scale: aprox 2/3."
title: Shaker Stove
